- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M's 'fast-fashion' strategy involves producing cheaper, trendier clothing in smaller quantities for quicker inventory turnover.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M has opened smaller stores in urban areas focusing on specific products popular in those areas.
- [USER] User expressed appreciation for H&M's move towards sustainable fashion and asked about other initiatives in this area.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M aims to use only sustainably sourced and recycled materials by 2030, including organic cotton and recycled polyester.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M is partnering with companies for garment recycling and textile-to-textile recycling to reduce clothing waste.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M has a global garment collection program encouraging customers to bring in old clothes for reuse or recycling, collecting over 100,000 tons of textiles since 2013.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M's Conscious Collection features clothing made from sustainable materials, including organic cotton and recycled polyester.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M is investing in energy-efficient stores with features like LED lighting and solar panels.
- [USER] User inquired about H&M's plans to expand sustainable initiatives to other areas of their business.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M is committed to scaling sustainable initiatives across all business areas, including sustainable materials, water stewardship, and social issues in the supply chain.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M has joined the Fashion Industry Charter for Climate Action, committing to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 30% by 2030 and using 100% renewable electricity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] H&M's Fair Living Wage strategy aims to ensure fair wages for everyone in the supply chain by 2025.
